appearance_facts.fact: A single teal line connects four circular data points, rising continuously from the bottom-left to the top-right of the chart.
The line begins at the lowest vertical position on the page, aligned with the 260 mark on the y-axis.
The line rises to a point aligned with the 290 mark on the y-axis.
The line continues its ascent to a point aligned with the 330 mark on the y-axis.
The line terminates at its highest vertical position on the page, aligned with the 380 mark on the y-axis.
The trajectory shows a steady, uninterrupted upward slope across all visible years.

Label: 'Year' with tick marks for 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
Text: 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.

public_definitions: Sustained growth planning: for an enrollment pattern that indicates broad multi-year expansion.
Ongoing monitoring: for a more recent enrollment upswing that still warrants observation.
Decline-response assessment: for an enrollment pattern consistent with a downward trajectory.
uncertain: The chart displays data for 2017-2020, whereas the task instructions specify a '2013-2020 review window'; data for 2013-2016 is not visible.
